hero.lead: Discover the fascinating world of butterflies up close. Enjoy a guided experience among butterflies and nature.

tour.title: Butterfly Garden Tour
tour.body1: During the visit, you will discover how butterflies live and develop. Learn about their life cycle, from egg and caterpillar to chrysalis and adult butterfly, as well as their behaviour, feeding and reproduction.
tour.body2: Your guide will also explain how environmental conditions influence their development, characteristics that help us understand them better, and their role within the ecosystem.
tour.audience: An experience for many ages, from kindergarten and school groups to families, adults and older adults.

header.title: Butterflies
header.lead: Discover the fascinating world of butterflies: their transformation, habits and relationship with their surroundings.

opening.title: A remarkable transformation
opening.body1: A butterfly’s life cycle moves through several stages: egg, caterpillar, chrysalis and adult butterfly. During the tour, you can understand this process better and discover how it changes throughout development.
opening.body2: Their behaviour, feeding and development depend on plants and the conditions of the environment where they live.

header.title: Butterflies and Their Environment
header.lead: Butterflies depend on plants and the conditions around them to complete their life cycle. Discover why that relationship matters for biodiversity.

main.alt: Jardín de Mariposas La Paz in Bajo La Paz, San Ramón
main.title: A home for butterflies
main.body: Butterflies need plants throughout different stages of their lives. Some provide food, while others are part of their development and shelter.
main.illustrationAlt: Butterfly resting on a yellow flower

why.title: Signs of a healthy ecosystem
why.body: Butterflies appear where there is food and shelter: flowers for nectar and plants for development. Their presence can be a good sign that an environment is alive.

cta.title: Learning also helps us value
cta.body: During the visit, you can learn more about butterflies’ relationship with their surroundings and their importance within the ecosystem.
